claims.statement: Arm B achieves 50.83% accuracy on DEV MCQA Clean (n=120) and 62.03% on DEV Relation (n=482).
TempUN Small 180 evaluation contains 60 records sharing source_record_id with train_nwp.jsonl and 120 clean held-out records.
C_WRONG_YEAR identical predictions to C_TRUE (delta=0.0) stem from untreated bypass (144 cases) and lack of year perturbation in evaluation dispatch (36 cases).
Accuracy drop from Base model (32.22%) to Arm B (24.44%) on TempUN Small is not statistically significant (McNemar chi2=1.9205, p=0.1654 > 0.05).
Heldout NTP CE=1.1723 and PPL=3.23 are reported as aggregate measure across 2504 tokens, without paired arm-level comparison.
Gatekeeper P0-P8 passed with zero leakage in relation and MCQA splits, frozen backbone, and syntax valid rate=1.0.
